notes.text: Review remaining setup with nimbus postinstall status; task help explains prerequisites and native actions.
Open a new terminal after installation to load shell and Mise configuration.
Mise installs the agent CLIs and AI Usage. Sign into Claude, Grok and Codex, then connect Codex and OpenRouter in OpenCode. See the Chezmoi README first-login checklist.

Open 1Password, sign in and enable Integrate with 1Password CLI in Settings > Developer. Enable the SSH agent only when you opt into SSH integration. Skip manual SSH/Git file edits; Chezmoi owns them.
Log into the Noctalia desktop to generate colors. Existing GUI overrides take precedence over managed settings; see Chezmoi's NOCTALIA.md.
Select Use GTK in Brave Appearance settings to follow the desktop theme.
Add calendar credentials in Noctalia; they stay in the local keyring. See Chezmoi's NOCTALIA.md for DAV settings.
